accueil.titreOnglet: Beauty Salon — online booking for beauty professionals
accueil.description: Your own page, online booking and a diary for hairdressers, nail technicians, make-up artists and barbers in Congo, the DRC and the diaspora.
accueil.intro: The booking platform for beauty professionals: hair, nails, make-up, barbering. Your own page, one diary, no double bookings.
accueil.essai: Free trial. No card details asked.

atouts.sous: Three things, and they hold together: a page you can share, a diary that never slips, a client list that stays yours.

vitrine.corps: A page in your name, with your photos, your prices and your opening hours. One link to share on WhatsApp, Instagram or TikTok.
vitrine.corpsCourt: A page in your name, with your photos and prices. One link to share on WhatsApp or Instagram.

agenda.corps: Your clients book at any hour, on a slot that is genuinely free. Two people can never take the same place.
agenda.corpsCourt: Your clients book at any hour, on a slot that is genuinely free. Never the same place twice.

gestion.corps: Your appointments, your team and your client list in one place. Your data stays yours, exportable at any time.
gestion.corpsCourt: Your appointments, your team and your clients in one place. Your data stays yours.

film.sous: A day at the salon: the requests coming in, the slot taken exactly once, the diary keeping up. Original music, no voice-over.

apercu.surtitre: Try it before you sign up
apercu.titre: What your page will look like
apercu.sous: Type your salon's name, pick your colours. No sign-up, no email asked.

etapes.sous: Three steps. The longest one takes three minutes.

creer.corps: Name, web address, country. Three minutes, no card details.

remplir.corps: Services, prices, opening hours, photos. Three services are enough to start.

partager.corps: On WhatsApp, in a story, or as a QR code on the salon wall. Bookings land in your diary.

questions.sous: Five answers, and nothing that commits you.

prix.q: Do I have to pay to start?
prix.a: No. Signing up is free and asks for no card details. You get a full trial period, and no invoice is issued before it ends.

miseEnLigne.q: Is my page online straight away?
miseEnLigne.a: Your web address is reserved the moment you sign up, but the page goes public once our team has checked it. You can prepare your catalogue and opening hours in the meantime.

seule.q: What if I work on my own?
seule.a: That is the most common case. Simply create your own provider profile: your hours and your appointments attach to it.

paiement.q: How do my clients pay me?
paiement.a: The way they do today: cash, Mobile Money or bank transfer. The platform tracks the deposits you ask for, and you mark a payment received in one click.

donnees.q: Can I get my data back?
donnees.a: Yes, at any time. Your client list and your appointment history belong to you.

appel.sous: Create your salon today, share your link tomorrow.
